description: A lone task with deadline 100 ns waits at a 2-party barrier nobody else reaches: no timer, no other task. The lab advances time to its budget-deadline timer, which cancels the waiter with Deadline at 100; it leaves the barrier cancelled. A scheduler that only wakes a parked task when something else does would end the run with the task parked (bd-9kll.4.16, the sweep's wake timer).
